text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after <chrname>
and I have
reached a milestone...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Good evening, Trainer

<username>. You've
been
working so hard despite how late
it's gotten.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Ahem... I was wondering, but... do you
have any
plans for tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If not, I was hoping we could spend
some time
together and have a friendly
discussion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, she takes me to a hill with
a scenic
view of the entire city.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The sky is so beautiful. The sun feels
warm too.
It's lovely.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I thought somewhere spacious, without
walls,
would be the best place to open
up one's heart.
choice_data_list: あの、今日はどうしてここに？

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Sometimes I wonder what I would be like
had I
never met you...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: If you hadn't changed my stubborn ways.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
When I claimed my goal was to protect
my
inexperienced racers' independence,
I was merely
trying to make myself look
good.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It was no better than neglect, the petty
excuse of
an irresponsible adult.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I created an exact path for my trainees
by
controlling every aspect of their lives.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I thought that so long as they never
strayed from
the path I laid, they had
nothing to fear.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That was the one and only way I had to
protect
them...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I forced them in a direction I chose
based on my
past experiences.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I demanded that they trust me, yet I
never tried
to understand them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I was a failure as an educator... and as a
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I mean it. You... and those precious
racers were
the ones who made me
realize my wrongs.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You remind me of how I was long

ago—passionate, honest, and trusting of
my
racers.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That similarity was all the more reason
why I
couldn't admit that you were
skilled.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Don't look so hopeful.
choice_data_list: 今は認めてくれているんですか？

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'm joking. It's impossible not to

acknowledge your greatness now.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You brought back a lot of memories I
needed
reminding of... and you taught
me so much.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
You are the best rival I could ever ask
for.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder where Trainer Kashimoto is. She

supposedly went this way, but I don't
see her...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Hey, don't hog the path!

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna be the one who finds her first!
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Excuse me? I'm going find her first!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Stomp, stomp, stomp!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I think I hear Little Cocon and Bitter
Glasse. What
are those two doing,
yelling in public like that?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I suppose our grown-up chat has to end
here.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, Trainer
<username>.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: My adorable students are waiting for me.
